description: Check whether one email address is a real mailbox. Costs 1 credit only when the mailbox is confirmed valid. Invalid, catch-all, unknown, and repeats are free and still return at 0 credits. A new valid mailbox fails at 0 balance; the error includes https://www.findleademails.com/pricing. The credit is spent after a valid result. This does not modify the mailbox.

email.description: The email address to check, for example jane.doe@company.com

name: verify_email
title: Verify one email
